source.rights: Third-party seller artwork selected by the Owner as calibration evidence. Never reproduce, never pass to a generator as image input, never publish. Only the transferable principles leave this record.
source.event_date_visible: Tuesday, April 29 · starting at noon CT · Online only

classification.event_product_type: Online-only specialty auction (mineral specimens + designer purses)

visual_read.visual_hierarchy: Title stack top-left (ROCK SPECIMEN dark serif, & and DESIGNER PURSE / AUCTION in orange, AUCTION largest) → date/time/online-only → 'Featuring' line → CTA box → seller logo bottom-left. Merchandise owns the right two-thirds and the whole lower half.
visual_read.merchandise_treatment: One real photographed still life of six mineral specimens (pink agate geode slice, clear quartz point, pyrite cluster, lapis block, labradorite slab, druzy heart) on a white marble surface with natural cast shadows. Not extracted — physically arranged and lit. Purses named in the title are not shown.
visual_read.composition_style: Left text column over a continuous photograph; objects rise from bottom-right toward the top-right so the title sits in the open marble at top-left. Thin orange rule frame around the whole ad.
visual_read.typography_treatment: Formal serif caps for the title with small-caps feel; heavy sans for date and 'ONLINE ONLY'; italic 'Featuring'. Orange as the single accent colour; ornamental divider glyphs.
visual_read.branding_hierarchy: Seller name and descriptor bottom-left at moderate size with the tagline 'Trusted. Experienced. Results.' — identity closes the ad rather than opening it.
visual_read.cta_treatment: One boxed CTA: 'BID ONLINE! LMAuctionCo.com' (cream rounded box, orange outline). Factual — the auction is online-only.
visual_read.footer_treatment: No band. Seller logo + tagline act as the footer; orange frame closes the canvas.
visual_read.photographic_style: Studio still-life photography on marble, soft directional light, real shadows and reflections.
visual_read.environmental_staged_composition: Physically staged tabletop still life; the marble surface is the environment.

strongest_attributes: Colour comes entirely from the merchandise (pink, blue, iridescent) on a near-white ground
Confident serif title with one accent colour and the biggest word being AUCTION
Real shadows and a real surface make the objects feel present and valuable
Text column leaves the objects uncovered; nothing overlaps merchandise
transferable_lessons: For a single-category specialty auction, a real photographed still life can replace extraction when the seller supplies a clean staged photo
Light ground + merchandise-supplied colour (validates the 3M.1 white/very-light default)
One accent colour used for emphasis words and the CTA outline only
A factual CTA ('online only' → 'bid online at <url>') is acceptable as a single quiet block
do_not_generalize: Orange accent palette, ornamental divider glyphs, thin decorative frame border — Lewis & Maese identity
Marble surface as a signature surface
Naming merchandise in the title that is not shown (purses) — Advantage.Bid creative must show what it names or name what it shows

text_density_assessment.why_it_works_here: Five copy blocks, but each is short and stacked in one column; the merchandise never competes with text.
text_density_assessment.advantage_bid_budget_note: Fits the existing 5-block budget exactly; the 'Featuring' line is the one supporting line.

composition_assessment.spatial_logic: Tabletop still life; objects lean and rest on each other physically.
composition_assessment.gravity_and_grounding: Real gravity — every specimen rests on the marble with a cast shadow.
composition_assessment.depth: Photographic depth of field; large geode slice behind, small druzy heart in front.
composition_assessment.scale_strategy: Natural relative scale; the largest specimen is the tallest and placed at the back.
composition_assessment.edge_handling: Objects touch or cross the right and bottom edges; nothing identifying is cropped.

provenance.analysis_method: Direct visual inspection of the full-resolution image; pixel statistics computed from the file; est_* fields are visual estimates. No filename-based inference.
